tip.text: Go see Wendy — she runs the arcade room next to the LinkedIn offices, and she might show you some ongoing projects. Enjoy your visit!

bye.text: And watch out for the little monsters along the way — you can attack them with the sword icon at the bottom-right!

intro.text: Hey! I'm John. Did you know Erwan started out building data tools before moving into full-stack development? He worked on ETL pipelines, business intelligence apps, and now interactive experiences like this one!

more.text: Yeah, he likes mixing domains. Data, code, games — he doesn't stick to just one box. You should check out his projects in the arcade room!

intro.text: BZZZT— Identification: RoboCop. Law enforcement unit… well, sort of. It's really just a costume but people still step out of the way in the street, so I keep it on.

billboard.text: Hey, did you see the billboard on your way here? That's the next game Erwan's working on — and honestly, it looks really promising!

details.text: There's already a trailer — the concept is solid, the atmosphere is really polished. The kind of project that makes you want to play from the first minute.

arcade.text: You'll find all the details at the arcade room — there's a dedicated machine. Go check it out, it's worth it!

bye.text: No worries! If you change your mind, the arcade room is right nearby.
